title: Factorial: compiled, not interpreted
tryThis: Change the loop to go up to 13 and run with **ASan + UBSan**: `13!` does not fit in a 32-bit `int`. Signed overflow is *undefined behaviour* in C++, and UBSan reports it. Python silently switches to big integers instead.
Replace `int` by `long long` (64-bit). How far can you go now? (Up to 20!)
